concepts.caption: Self-custody sounds harder than it is. We're answering five things people get wrong about holding your own Bitcoin, one myth per slide, one answer underneath.
concepts.headline: Five Myths About Self-Custody
concepts.mock_svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 1080 1350" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="1080" height="1350" fill="#FFFFFF"/><text x="540" y="150" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="54" fill="#3D3D3D" text-anchor="middle">Five Myths About Self-Custody</text><text x="540" y="400" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="40" fill="#3D3D3D" text-anchor="middle">"Self-custody is too risky."</text><line x1="300" y1="460" x2="780" y2="460" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="4"/><text x="540" y="520" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="36" fill="#BFBFBF" text-anchor="middle">You hold the keys, not an exchange.</text><circle cx="460" cy="1300" r="8" fill="#111111"/><circle cx="490" cy="1300" r="8" fill="#BFBFBF"/><circle cx="520" cy="1300" r="8" fill="#BFBFBF"/><circle cx="550" cy="1300" r="8" fill="#BFBFBF"/><circle cx="580" cy="1300" r="8" fill="#BFBFBF"/><rect x="990" y="1290" width="60" height="30" fill="#BFBFBF"/></svg>

concepts.novelty: That carousel covers general Bitcoin misconceptions; this one is scoped specifically to self-custody objections, hard, risky, unnecessary, only for experts, exchanges are safer, which haven't been addressed as a set.
concepts.purpose: Lower the perceived difficulty of self-custody by directly answering common objections.
concepts.rationale: Myth_rebuttal has only two entries on the board and self-custody is Relai's core differentiator, so a dedicated set earns its slot.
concepts.source_ref: Self-custody messaging theme, evidenced by 'They Have Your Savings Hostage', 'No One Can Freeze It' and the approved line 'Self-custody history lesson: Mt. Gox, QuadrigaCX, FTX, Celsius. Class dismissed.'
concepts.subject: Five self-custody myths, answered
concepts.target_feeling: Relief, self-custody feels less intimidating by the end.
concepts.visual_direction: Consistent template: the myth in quotes at the top of each slide, the one-line answer directly under it, divided by a thin rule. Relai orange only on the rule line.
